page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type deployed on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processors. The configuration provides 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, clocked at 2.55 GHz. Cache allocation includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 32 MB L3 cache. The CPU instruction set incorporates AVX, AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and BMI2, while omitting AVX-512 and AMX extensions. System memory measures 64 GB, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. No local disk storage or hardware accelerators are bundled into the instance profile, and networking operates at a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark measurements indicate strong single-core computational execution, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25 percent. Multi-core compute benchmarks, including Geekbench and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, fall within mid-range percentiles. Cached memory reads achieve 516.15 GB/sec, whereas large-block uncached memory read bandwidth of 37.69 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 17.66 GB/sec fall into lower performance tiers. The system delivers 7.68 million operations per second in Redis SET testing and achieves 8.59 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Natural language inference on small models reaches 183.76 generation tokens per second, but degrades significantly on medium-sized parameter models.

The primary architectural tradeoff of ecs.r7a.2xlarge centers on its substantial memory allocation relative to its lower uncached sequential memory bandwidth and 2 Gbps network baseline. Because no local storage is provided, instances rely entirely on remote network storage for persistence. The instance profile is economically balanced for workloads that demand significant RAM density without requiring extreme sustained sequential memory streaming. Primary workload fits include in-memory data structures such as Redis, moderate enterprise application runtimes, caching layers, and general memory-bound backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores operating at 2.55 GHz, paired with 64 GB of system RAM to establish an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The configuration includes 32 MB of L3 cache, hardware cryptography acceleration, and a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. No local storage volumes or discrete GPUs are integrated, requiring network-attached storage for stateful deployments. Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-core processing capabilities and average multi-core efficiency, accompanied by mid-tier Redis throughput of 7.68 million operations per second. However, uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidth remain modest. This hardware profile is appropriate for in-memory key-value caching, intermediate enterprise database services, and memory-intensive backend applications.
